legend: The pigmented subtype has pigment-laden dendritic cells.

The majority of tumours harbour a t(17;22) translocation resulting in a fusion of PDGFB with the promoter region of COL1A1 via multiple breakpoints. The resulting protein is constitutively expressed and processed to a normal PDGFB ligand, driving oncogenesis.
